description: This file defines the Subscription controller for the OpenCart API, handling subscription-related API endpoints such as cart retrieval, product addition, checkout confirmation, and subscription history updates. It implements various API methods for managing subscriptions within the shopping cart flow.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: API controller class for managing subscription operations within OpenCart, including retrieving cart details, adding products, confirming subscriptions, and updating subscription history.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for handling different API calls based on the 'call' parameter in the request.

methods.name: setCustomer
methods.description: Logs in the customer based on provided customer ID and sets customer info in session.

methods.name: setPaymentAddress
methods.description: Sets the payment address in the session based on provided address ID.

methods.name: setShippingAddress
methods.description: Sets the shipping address in the session based on provided address ID.

methods.name: getShippingMethods
methods.description: Prepares and returns available shipping methods for the current cart.

methods.name: getPaymentMethods
methods.description: Prepares and returns available payment methods for the current cart.

methods.name: setPaymentMethod
methods.description: Sets the payment method after validating cart and addresses.

methods.name: getCart
methods.description: Retrieves cart details including products, shipping, and payment options.

methods.name: addProduct
methods.description: Adds a product to the cart and returns updated cart data.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Confirms and finalizes a subscription, performing validation and adding the subscription to database.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a history comment or status update to an existing subscription.
